subject: Marine Works - Esquimalt Harbour
text:
Marine Works - Esquimalt Harbour
Pier construction will take place on Jetty A at the Esquimalt Naval Base.
Operations active 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. 
Pilings are in place with yellow quick flashing lights marking a no-go zone around the Jetty.
All vessels entering Esquimalt Harbour are required to check in with KHM Operations on VHF channel 10 or by phone at 250-363-2160.
Minimum wake.
